about: Pisa Learn's evaluation set (LEARN-1): 50 questions over open arXiv papers on white-box monitoring of LLMs (probes, truth directions, representation engineering, circuit breakers). Only ids, questions and gold locations; the papers are fetched from arXiv at run time and never committed (arXiv licence: personal and research use; no re-hosting).

papers.title: The Internal State of an LLM Knows When It's Lying
papers.why: Probing: SAPLMA, an MLP probe on hidden-layer activations of OPT-6.7b / LLAMA2-7b for statement truthfulness, with per-layer accuracy tables and held-out-topic evaluation.

papers.title: The Geometry of Truth: Emergent Linear Structure in Large Language Model Representations of True/False Datasets
papers.why: Probing: truth directions in LLaMA-2 (patching, PCA, LR/mass-mean/CCS probes, causal interventions), with appendices on per-layer structure and dataset construction.

papers.title: Inference-Time Intervention: Eliciting Truthful Answers from a Language Model
papers.why: Probing and representation engineering: per-attention-head linear probes on TruthfulQA and steering along truthful directions (ITI), with ablations on directions, K/alpha and head selection.

papers.title: Refusal in Language Models Is Mediated by a Single Direction
papers.why: Guardrails and probing: a difference-in-means refusal direction, directional ablation / weight orthogonalization as a jailbreak, with appendix on direction selection per layer.

papers.title: Detecting Strategic Deception Using Linear Probes
papers.why: Deception monitoring: logistic-regression probes on the residual stream of Llama-3.3-70B (layer 22 of 80) trained on Instructed-Pairs/Roleplaying and tested on insider trading and sandbagging, with a 1%-FPR control calibration and appendix sweeps over layer, fitting method and aggregation.

papers.title: Improving Alignment and Robustness with Circuit Breakers
papers.why: Representation engineering: Representation Rerouting (LoRRA on layers 10 and 20) that breaks harmful internal processes before output, plus harmfulness probes on chosen layers as a white-box monitor, with representation analyses and a RepE attack on set layers.
